mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)

## date range selection

```{r}
dr_row_loglin <- function(row, fmat, method=NULL, complete=TRUE) {
  row_nt <- row[-1] 
  
  if (sum(!is.na(row_nt)) < 2) {
    warning("Insufficient data to construct log-linear fit for row(s).")
    return(row_nt) 
  }
  
  row_mask <- !is.na(row_nt) 
  return(row_nt[row_mask]) 
  rloglin <- approxfun(x = fmat[row_mask], y = log(row_nt[row_mask])) 
  
  int_row <- exp(rloglin(fmat))
  
  return(int_row) 
}

dr_row_loglin(asdf[1,], mats)
```
